description: The sleeps of one NIGHT from /247samples. A date means the night of that date: sleeps that began between 12:00 on it and 12:00 the next day (the watch's local time), so last night is under yesterday's date and an afternoon nap belongs to the night after it. One row per sleep (longest revision kept): entryData has SleepId, IsNap, BedtimeStart/End, Duration (s), Deep/Light/REMSleepDuration (s), SleepQualityScore, AvgHRV (ms), HRAvg, HRMin (bpm). IsNap is true for sleeps under about 3 hours and can flip while recording, so it also marks a fragment of a split night: do not drop rows by IsNap alone; group rows by BedtimeStart and Duration yourself. [] when no sleep began in the window. Needs the Sleep API subscription (404 without).

date.description: Date of the NIGHT, YYYY-MM-DD, not the wake-up date. Last night is under yesterday's date.
